description: IN-SCOPE: Must verify 4 toggle states (Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Annually). Must default to 'Monthly'. Must immediately trigger API refetch upon change. OUT-OF-SCOPE: Exporting data to CSV/PDF from this toggle.
IN-SCOPE: Verify positive growth shows '+' and text color #4CAF50. Verify negative growth shows '-' and text color #F44336. Values > 1,000,000 must render with 'M'.

IN-SCOPE: Must load under 1.5 seconds under 100 QPS load. Must validate X-Timezone-Offset header and return currentPeriodRevenue, growthPercentage, and chartData. Aggregation must map transactions using exact transaction_date 3rd-party currency rates fetched from MongoDB.
IN-SCOPE: Job fires at 00:00 UTC. Test 3-retry mechanism on 1-hour intervals. Test complete-failure fallback logic returning exactly yesterday's rate from DB_COLL_02.

IN-SCOPE: API must reject unauthorized requests with HTTP 401. Must properly resolve and decode token payload via Internal Auth Microservice JWKS endpoint. Enforce Region data isolation based on token payload.
